description: Two to four prop firms side by side from each firm's own pages: cheapest plan at the account size asked, cost to reach funded, profit split, drawdown, platforms, news-trading rule and the date we read them. Prices are without any promo code. Each firm links its facts page to cite.

account_size.description: Account size in USD, for example 50000. Default: each firm's cheapest plan to reach funded.

country.description: Where the trader lives: a two-letter code or a country name. Adds what each firm's own country list says.

name: compare_prop_firms
title: Compare prop firms side by side
